prompt: C#: regenerate stamina up to its maximum.
target: static int Regenerate(int stamina, int amount, int max) => Math.Clamp(stamina + Math.Max(0, amount), 0, max);

prompt: C#: clamp player speed to a nonnegative maximum.
target: static float ClampSpeed(float speed, float max) => Math.Clamp(speed, 0f, max);

prompt: C#: report invulnerability while remaining time is positive.
Godot C#: check Vector2 distance using squared values.
target: static bool WithinRange(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, float range) => a.DistanceSquaredTo(b) < range * range;
